messages:
ivy.chen: hey all — day 2 here. quick checklist: who should I ask for (1) a temp API key to try the hosted endpoints, (2) read-only access to the metrics DB for a small query set, and (3) VPC peering so my laptop can hit staging redis? also who owns the weekly oncall schedule? sorry if this is scattered, i scanned docs and still fuzzy :slightly_smiling_face:
aj: welcome @ivy.chen! TL;DR: api keys -> @liz-devex, db access -> infra access flow (#eng-infra-access), vpc -> @tony-infra (networking). oncall schedule -> eng-sre (cc @sre-maria).
liz-devex: hey @ivy.chen — i can issue a short-lived API key. DM me your github email and which project you9re testing. i9ll also drop the quickstart link: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard/api-keys (internal). :wave:

if you need the key via CLI later, run:
```
redwood auth create --scope=api:hosted --ttl=2h --note="ivy-day2"
```

(That command is the devex helper; i9ll create one now and ping you.)
tony-infra: for VPC peering we need a Jira ticket in INFRA with these fields: project, environment, requester CIDR, target VPC, and justification. Minimal example to paste into the ticket:
```
Project: my-first-feature
Env: staging
Requester CIDR: 203.0.113.45/32
Target VPC: prod-staging-vpc (vpc-0abc123)
Justification: debugging redis conn for local dev
```
I'll triage once it's created. if you want a temporary SSH tunnel while we approve, say so.
sre-maria: oncall rota is in the ops rota page: https://redwood.internal/rota — infra incidents are SRE, product infra ownerships are mapped per service in the org chart. new hires usually shadow the weekend shift once with a buddy. ping me if you9d like to be added to the read-only pager list for alerts. :loudspeaker:
devops-bot: Note: Access requests will be processed only after 2FA and SSO enrollment. If you haven9t finished SSO, go to https://login.redwood.internal/setup.

recruiter-sam: welcome aboard @ivy.chen! we9re doing a new-hires lunch tomorrow at 12:30 in kitchen B — swing by to meet folks.

ivy.chen: thanks everyone — @liz-devex i9ll DM my email now. @tony-infra opening the INFRA ticket with that sample, thanks. @sre-maria yes please add me to the read-only pager list for staging so I can see alerts during testing. appreciate the quick answers :heart:
